description: Phase 2 held-out validation set for Julia execution-class routing. Newly authored cases, NOT paraphrases of the Phase 1 calibration set. Used only to confirm a candidate method after it is frozen on the calibration set; never used to select thresholds, exemplars, or ensemble rules.

cases.state: Correct the capitalization in a section heading.
Remove a duplicated blank line in a config file.
Fix a typo in a changelog entry.
Delete a commented-out dead line in a small function.
Add a missing period to a doc comment.
Reorder imports to satisfy the formatter in one file.
Fix a broken anchor link in a markdown page.
Rename a boolean field inside one struct and update its uses.
Fix a log message that prints the wrong variable name.
Update a version string in a documentation example.
Add a limit parameter to an existing report query and apply it in the SQL builder.
Extend an existing enum and its switch statements to handle a new status.
Split a large function into two helpers within the same file.
Add JSON serialization tests for an existing response type.
Implement an existing interface on a new small type used by one caller.
Add a default value to an existing configuration option and document it.
Change an HTTP handler to return 404 instead of 200 when a record is missing, updating its tests.
Cache the result of an existing expensive helper in the same package.
Add a new field to an internal metrics struct and populate it in one place.
Fix a nil-pointer panic in an existing helper by adding a guard.
Introduce per-tenant data isolation across the storage and query layers.
Change the authentication flow to support refresh tokens with rotation.
Redesign the job scheduler to support priority preemption.
Introduce distributed locking for cross-node coordination.
Change the retry and backoff policy for the primary execution path.
Implement data retention with irreversible deletion of old records.
Rework the approval workflow to allow parallel approvers.
Introduce a service mesh boundary between internal services.
Change the encryption-at-rest strategy for the database.
Replace the synchronous request path with an event-driven pipeline.
